newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 66,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 66,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 66,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in two shipments from a variety of suppliers at a tender on Friday, traders said.
Suppliers Continental, Harvest and Colombia Grain all will contribute parts of Friday's contracted shipments.
Freight for the first shipment was fixed at US$19.88 per tonne and the second was at US$19.78 per tonne, traders said.
The shipments contain dark northern spring (DNS), hard red winter (HRW) and white wheat (WW) and all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.
